The '''Battle of Iridonia''' was a battle fought above [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. During the battle, [[Acaadi]] attempted to sabotage the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Champion of Iridonia]]'' and a number of Republic ships defected to the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].
